scripts.setup: cd server && npm install && node db/migrate.js && node db/seed.js
scripts.pages:build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r assets css js admin ifa fund portal team _data index.html login.html signup.html manifest.json dist/ && echo '[/api/*]\nurl = https://svcapital-production.up.railway.app/api/:splat\nstatus = 200' > dist/_redirects
scripts.cap:android: cd mobile && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:build:android: npm run build:mobile && npm run apply:android && npm run check:android && cd mobile && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.add:android: cd mobile && npx cap add android
scripts.add:ios: cd mobile && npx cap add ios
